notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - June 9th
notes.content:
We're so back


 Updated to Unreal Engine 5.5
 Significantly reduced disk size and slightly reduced vram usage
 New visuals in tavern map
 Misc bug fixes
 Improved some weapons that were kind of shit (burst rifle, machine gun)
 *Hopefully* fixed softlock that could sometimes happen when opening Thresh's store

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 21st
notes.content:
Fixed issue where crashing at a certain point during the intro would crash the game
 Reduced Vram usage
 Misc bug fixes

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 6th
notes.content:
Improved some questionable looking textures

 Other bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 5th
notes.content:
Significant reduction in Vram Usage in certain maps

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 4th #2
notes.content:
Performance increases on low end hardware
 Fixed issue on steam deck with loading into desert arena (takes significantly less time to load in than before, still takes a little while though lol)
 Misc bug fixes and balancing changes

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 4th

notes.title: Harbinger Update Notes - October 3rd
notes.content:
Added new cap to the number of arena waves at 12 to prevent combat from getting boring
 New accessibility options
 New option to disable taking damage on missed shots
